examples.explanation: The first n elements of ans are the same as nums. For the next n = 3 elements, each element is taken from nums in reverse order: ans[3] = nums[2] = 3 ans[4] = nums[1] = 2 ans[5] = nums[0] = 1 Thus, ans = [1, 2, 3, 3, 2, 1].
The array remains the same when reversed. Thus, ans = [1, 1].
